title: Hard Sample Aware Prompt-Tuning

layout.note: Two lettered panels stacked. (a) on top is a row of four rounded frames (sentences, labels, predictions, stratified cards) joined by two block chevrons. (b) below is the training diagram: an EASY input frame, a cylinder encoder, a cylinder MLM head and a dash-dot loss box in one row, with a wide HARD frame (hard input plus positive and negative rows) along the bottom; the letters sit centred under each panel.

lesson: Trace the same example sentences from a raw data column through labels and predictions into coloured stratum cards, then carry the stratum colours into the dashed arrows of the training diagram, so one colour code ties data triage to model training.
